title: UPSTREAM | DOWNSTREAM
blurb: A sinuous spine of timber and fabric, twin paths of lift and descent, mirroring the flow of salmon.

title: Gravity Pool
blurb: A massive arching structure that looks like a celestial creature swimming through space.

title: Mountains of Sound
blurb: Walk through sculpted Mt. Hood, Mt. St. Helens and Mt. Adams, with the tallest peak a DJ stage.

title: Coyote Cove
blurb: An Oregon Coast estuary where the youngest coyote pups guide the salmon back upstream.

title: Bramble
blurb: An installation beside the Lucky Barn, its materials planned for shelter bike corrals and housing.

title: Timbre Grove
blurb: A pulsating forest of light and sound, designed by the architects of Portland's airport.
